question: A 45-year-old man presents with unilateral nasal obstruction. Anterior rhinoscopy reveals a pale, smooth, gelatinous mass in the right nasal cavity. Which statement best characterises the clinical significance of this finding?

answers.text: Unilateral nasal polyps are the typical presentation of ethmoidal polyposis and require only medical management.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Ethmoidal polyps arising from allergy or chronic rhinosinusitis are characteristically bilateral. A unilateral polyp should raise suspicion for a neoplastic or vascular cause.

answers.text: A unilateral nasal polyp mandates further evaluation to exclude a neoplastic or vascular lesion before any intervention.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Unilateral nasal polyps are a red flag. The differential includes inverted papilloma, angiofibroma, and malignancy. Biopsy of a suspected vascular mass (e.g., JNA) without prior imaging and preparation carries a risk of catastrophic haemorrhage.

answers.text: The pale gelatinous appearance confirms an allergic aetiology regardless of laterality.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Gross morphology alone cannot confirm aetiology. Laterality is a crucial distinguishing feature — allergic/inflammatory polyps are bilateral; a unilateral lesion with this appearance requires histopathological and radiological evaluation.

answers.text: Bilateral nasal obstruction is more clinically significant than unilateral obstruction in adults.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Unilateral nasal obstruction is generally the more sinister presentation because it raises the possibility of a unilateral structural or neoplastic lesion, whereas bilateral obstruction is more commonly benign (DNS, bilateral polyps, rhinitis).

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the aetiology section. Laterality is the single most important discriminating feature when evaluating a nasal mass.
Well done. Unilateral polyp = red flag. Always rule out neoplasm or vascular mass before treating empirically.
